answer: Re-attestations are stored in signal and thread lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the lotus graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1790 impostors cost 1814 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
